name: sap-abap-mcp
description: Develop, test, analyze, and operate SAP ABAP systems through ADT from AI coding agents.
long_description: SAP ABAP MCP is a local-first Model Context Protocol server that enables AI coding agents to develop, test, analyze, and operate SAP ABAP systems through the official ABAP Development Tools HTTP services. It supports repository search and source editing, paged package navigation, source-backed object creation, semantic services, activation, ABAP Unit and ATC, transports, abapGit, RAP generation, debugging, bounded class profiling, runtime dumps and traces, cross-system comparison, dependency analysis, and guarded refactoring. Curated compact, development, and assurance presets reduce tool-schema token use without removing capabilities from the default surface. The default local stdio mode can be extended with governed self-hosted Streamable HTTP, API-key roles, OIDC/JWT authentication, per-session isolation, rate limits, structured audit logs, or a side-effect-free embeddable Node.js API. It also includes a read-only transport assurance CLI and GitHub Action, BTP service-key profile import, and live-SAP evidence tooling. SAP profiles and credentials remain on the user's computer, with passwords protected by macOS Keychain or Windows DPAPI. SAP-dependent capabilities are validated against the user's own SAP release, configuration, and authorizations.
